    normalExponentDegree a ≤ normalExponentDegree b := by

/-!
# Relative principalization from given resolutions of marked ideals

Hironaka phase H5a (design I-0981 C-0161): the geometry of `hir:factorization-from-resolution`
(`blueprint/src/hironaka.tex`), with the two resolutions of the proof taken as hypotheses.  Blueprint
`mc:factorization-ambient`, `mc:factorization-thin-centre`, `mc:factorization-tower`, `mc:factorization-second`,
`mc:factorization-assembly` (`blueprint/src/maximal-contact.tex`).  Source: Copy-4
(`transcendental-nakamaye-copy4-20260911`), the proof of `lem:relative-principalization`, identities `eq:rp-induction`.

Let `𝔪 = (X, N, E, 𝔞, 1)` be a marked ideal with mark one, `N` a closed submanifold and `𝔞` coherent, and
`𝔪' = (X, X, E, 𝔞, 1)` the same data with `N` replaced by the whole manifold.  Along a multiple test blow-up `T` of `𝔪`
the ideal of the transform `𝔪_T` is an ideal of `𝒪_{N_T}`, represented by a colon ideal along `N_T`; the transform
`𝔪'_T` carries the ambient controlled transform `𝔞'_T = 𝒪(E_T)·T^*𝔞`.  Copy-4's third identity
`Res_{W_i} 𝔞_i = 𝔟_i` says that the two agree along `N_T`.

## Main results

* `ambient 𝔪`: the marked ideal `(X, X, E, 𝔞, d)`; `cosupp_eq_inter_zeroLocus` (mark one: `cosupp = N ∩ Z(𝔞)`);
* **`isGeoTestTower_and_restrictEquiv`**: every multiple test blow-up `T` of `𝔪` is one of `𝔪'`, and `𝔪_T` is
  restricted-equivalent to `𝔪_T` with its ideal replaced by `𝔞'_T`; `cosupp_geoTransformAlong_eq`: hence
  `cosupp 𝔪_T = N_T ∩ Z(𝔞'_T)`;
* one blowup along a thin centre `C` inside a closed connected submanifold `N` of dimension `k`:
  `lt_of_regularAtDim_of_frequently` (`dim C < k`), `mem_exceptionalLocus_of_regularAtDim` (codimension `≥ 2`: every point
  over `C` is exceptional), `isPreconnected_preimage_of_disjoint`, `mem_geoStrictTransform_iff_of_notMem`,
  **`geoStrictTransform_data`** (`N' = closure (π⁻¹(N \ C))` is the strict transform `closure (π⁻¹N \ Exc π)` and a closed
  connected submanifold of dimension `k`), `pullback_vanishingIdeal_eq_of_disjoint` (`π^*𝓘_A = 𝓘_{π⁻¹A}` for `A ∩ C = ∅`);
* along a multiple test blow-up `T` of `𝔪` in the domain, with mark one and `N` a closed connected submanifold of
  dimension `k < n`: `support_add_subset`, `frequently_mem_N_notMem_of_isInvDomain`, **`tower_data`** -- `N_T` is a closed
  connected submanifold of dimension `k` and the strict transform of `N`; `T` is adapted to `N`;
  `T^*𝓘_N = 𝒪(-E_T)·𝓘_{N_T}` (Copy-4's first identity); the support of `E_T` lies in `Exc T`;
* the second stage, for `(X, X, E, 𝔟, 1)` with `𝔟` coherent and a closed connected submanifold `A` of dimension `k` missing
  `Z(𝔟)`: `disjoint_preimage_of_isAdmissibleCentre` (admissible centres along a test tower `S` miss `S⁻¹A`), **`second_data`**
  (`S⁻¹A` is a closed connected submanifold of dimension `k` and the strict transform of `A`, `E_S` misses it,
  `S^*𝓘_A = 𝓘_{S⁻¹A}`);
* the assembly: `pullDivisor` (`S^*D`, with `pullDivisor_ideal`, `support_pullDivisor`), `idealPow_one_of_isCoherent`,
  `isAdaptedBlowupSequence_comp`, `lt_of_ne_univ`, **`factorizationData_of_isGeoResolution`** (from a resolution `T₁` of
  `(Y, W, ∅, 𝔞, 1)` and a resolution `T₂` of `(Y_t, Y_t, ∅, 𝔞_t, 1)`, `𝔞_t` the ambient controlled transform along `T₁`: the body of
  `RelativePrincipalization.FactorizationData W k 𝔞`, written out, with `f = T₁ ∘ T₂`, `H = T₂^*E_{T₁}`, `H' = E_{T₂}`) and
  **`factorizationData_of_exists_resolution`** (the same from the existence of resolutions of every marked ideal of the domain
  in dimension `≤ j`, `n ≤ j`, on compact manifolds -- the output of a resolution invariant's driver).

`RelativePrincipalization` is not imported: its `FactorizationData` is written out in the conclusions above (checked
definitionally equal by a throwaway probe outside the repository).

Import discipline (Hironaka phase): this module does not import, even transitively,
`Pending.RelativePrincipalization` or `Pending.EmbeddedResolution`.  Sorry-free.
-/

open Set Filter
open scoped Topology Manifold

universe u

namespace TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.FactorizationFromResolution

open FirstPass FirstPass.HolomorphicIdealSheaves FirstPass.BlowupSequences
open TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.BlowupTowers TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.MarkedIdeals
  TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.MarkedIdeals.MarkedIdeal TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.GermIdealOrder
  TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.MarkedIdealOperationsAlong.MarkedIdeal
  TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.BlowupControlledTransform TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.BlowupExceptionalDivisor
open TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.ResolutionInvariantSpec (IsInvDomain)

noncomputable section

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- The cosupport of a marked ideal with mark one and coherent ideal is `N ∩ Z(𝔞)`. -/
theorem cosupp_eq_inter_zeroLocus {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M]
    [IsComplexManifold n M] {𝔫 : MarkedIdeal n M} (hd : 𝔫.d = 1) (h : 𝔫.ideal.IsCoherent) :
    𝔫.cosupp = 𝔫.N ∩ 𝔫.ideal.zeroLocus := by
  rw [MarkedIdeal.cosupp, hd]
  exact cosupport_one fun _ _ hg => SubmanifoldRestrictLe.holomorphicAt_of_mem_of_isCoherent h hg

/-- **Points of the submanifold off a centre accumulate at the centre**: for `𝔫` in the domain with mark one and an
admissible centre `C`, every point of `C` is a limit of points of `N \ C` (a germ of `𝔞` nonzero along `N` does not vanish
at nearby points of `N`, which therefore lie off the cosupport). -/
theorem frequently_mem_N_notMem_of_isInvDomain {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M]
    [IsComplexManifold n M] {𝔫 : MarkedIdeal n M} {k : ℕ} (h : IsInvDomain k 𝔫) (hd : 𝔫.d = 1) {C : Set M}
    (hC : C ⊆ 𝔫.cosupp) : ∀ c ∈ C, ∃ᶠ y in 𝓝 c, y ∈ 𝔫.N ∧ y ∉ C := by
  intro c hc
  have hcoh := h.isWellFormed.isCoherent
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hfr⟩ := h.isNonzeroAlongAt c (𝔫.cosupp_subset_N (hC hc))
  refine (hfr.and_eventually (HadamardBridge.eventually_mem_of_isCoherent hcoh hg)).mono ?_
  rintro y ⟨⟨hyN, hgy⟩, hmem⟩
  refine ⟨hyN, fun hyC => hgy ?_⟩
  have hy := hC hyC
  rw [cosupp_eq_inter_zeroLocus hd hcoh] at hy
  exact hy.2 g hmem

/-!
# Restriction of forms and theta-PSH potentials to an open submanifold

Let `M` be a complex manifold and `U` an open subset, a complex manifold with the restricted
charts `(chartAt x).subtypeRestr` (`TopologicalSpace.Opens.instChartedSpace`,
`AnalyticSubsetOpens.instIsComplexManifoldOpens`).  The inclusion `Subtype.val : U → M` is
holomorphic, and forms, Kähler backgrounds and theta-PSH functions restrict along it:

* `restrictForm U θ` — the closed real `(1,1)`-form `θ|_U` (the pullback along the inclusion);
  in the preferred chart of `U` at `y` its coefficient is that of `θ` in the preferred chart of
  `M` at `y` (`restrictForm_coeff_chartAt`);
* `restrictKahler U ω` — a Kähler background restricts to a Kähler background;
* `thetaPlurisubharmonic_restrict`, `locallyNondegenerate_restrict`,
  `isThetaPshPotential_restrict` — theta-PSH potentials restrict.

The converse is the point of this module.  A theta-PSH witness (a smooth local potential `ρ` of
`θ` with `u + ρ` PSH) in one chart transports to any other chart at the same point
(`exists_witness_of_chart`, holomorphic pullback along the chart transition), so:

* `thetaPlurisubharmonicOn_of_restrict` — if `G|_U` is `θ|_U`-PSH, then `G` is `θ`-PSH over `U`;
* `thetaPlurisubharmonic_piecewise` — on a clopen `U`, a function equal to a `θ|_U`-PSH
  function on `U` and to a `θ`-PSH function off `U` is `θ`-PSH on `M`.

This is the reusable half of the reduction of statements about compact Kähler manifolds to
their connected components (`Pending.OpensRestrictionMeasure` carries the measures and the
envelopes).  Sorry-free.
-/

open Set Filter TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff

namespace TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.OpensRestriction

open FirstPass FirstPass.HolomorphicMaps FirstPass.PositiveClasses
  FirstPass.AnalyticGluingData

noncomputable section

variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M]
  [IsComplexManifold n M]

/-! ### The inclusion of an open submanifold -/

variable (U : Opens M)

omit [IsComplexManifold n M] in
/-- The inclusion of an open submanifold is holomorphic. -/
theorem contMDiff_val :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) ∞ (Subtype.val : U → M) :=
  contMDiff_subtype_val

variable {U}

omit [IsComplexManifold n M] in
/-- The preferred chart of `U` at `y` is the preferred chart of `M` at `y`, restricted. -/
theorem complexChartAt_opens_val (y : U) :
    (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val =
      (chartAt (ComplexModel n) (y : M)).subtypeRestr ⟨y⟩ := rfl

/-- The target of the preferred chart of `U` at `y` lies in that of `M`. -/
theorem complexChartAt_opens_target_subset (y : U) :
    (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.target ⊆ (complexChartAt (n := n) (y : M)).val.target := by
  rw [complexChartAt_opens_val]
  exact (chartAt (ComplexModel n) (y : M)).subtypeRestr_target_subset ⟨y⟩

/-- The inverse of the preferred chart of `U`, read in `M`. -/
theorem val_complexChartAt_opens_symm (y : U) {z : ComplexModel n}
    (hz : z ∈ (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.target) :
    ((complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.symm z : M) =
      (complexChartAt (n := n) (y : M)).val.symm z := by
  rw [complexChartAt_opens_val] at hz ⊢
  exact (chartAt (ComplexModel n) (y : M)).subtypeRestr_symm_apply ⟨y⟩ hz

omit [IsComplexManifold n M] in
theorem complexChartAt_opens_apply (y : U) :
    (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val y = (complexChartAt (n := n) (y : M)).val (y : M) := rfl

/-- The coordinate expression of the inclusion in the preferred charts at `y` is the identity on
the chart target of `U`. -/
theorem coordinateMap_val_complexChartAt (y : U) {z : ComplexModel n}
    (hz : z ∈ (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.target) :
    coordinateMap (Subtype.val : U → M) (complexChartAt (n := n) y)
      (complexChartAt (n := n) (y : M)) z = z := by
  simp only [coordinateMap, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [val_complexChartAt_opens_symm y hz]
  exact (complexChartAt (n := n) (y : M)).val.right_inv (complexChartAt_opens_target_subset y hz)

/-!
# Measures, pluripolar sets and envelopes on a clopen open submanifold

Let `M` be a compact complex manifold and `U` a nonempty clopen subset, for instance a connected
component.  `U` is a compact complex manifold (`Pending.OpensRestriction`), and the objects of
global pluripotential theory on `M` restrict to `U` without change:

* `exceptionalLocus_val`, `isIsomorphismOver_val` — the inclusion is an isomorphism over `U`;
* `globalMixedMeasure_restrict_apply` — **the global mixed non-pluripolar measure is local**:
  `⟨⋀ (θᵢ|_U)_{uᵢ|_U}⟩(val⁻¹ S) = ⟨⋀ (θᵢ)_{uᵢ}⟩(S ∩ U)` for measurable `S`
  (from `ModificationMassInvariance.globalMixedMeasure_restrict_preimage_eq_map` with
  `π = Subtype.val`), and `diagonalPotentialMeasure_restrict_apply`;
* `manifoldLocallyPluripolar_preimage_val`, `manifoldLocallyPluripolar_image_val` — pluripolar
  sets restrict to `U` and extend from `U` (chart change by `locallyPluripolarAt_chartTransition`);
* `uscRegularization_comp_val` and `rooftopEnvelope_restrict` — usc regularization and the
  rooftop envelope commute with the restriction (competitors restrict, and a competitor on `U`
  glues with a competitor on `M` across the clopen `U`);
* `measure_eq_zero_of_forall_connectedComponent` — a set is null as soon as its trace on every
  connected component is null.

This is the general mechanism by which a statement about compact Kähler manifolds proved under
`[ConnectedSpace M]` extends to every compact Kähler manifold.  Sorry-free.
-/

open Set Filter TopologicalSpace MeasureTheory
open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff ENNReal

namespace TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.OpensRestrictionMeasure

open FirstPass FirstPass.HolomorphicMaps FirstPass.PositiveClasses FirstPass.BlowupSequences
  OpensRestriction

noncomputable section

variable {n : ℕ} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace (ComplexModel n) M]
  [IsComplexManifold n M] {U : Opens M}

/-- The derivative of the inclusion is the identity in the preferred charts. -/
theorem mfderiv_val_bijective (y : U) :
    Function.Bijective
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) (Subtype.val : U → M) y) := by
  have hd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n)
      (Subtype.val : U → M) y := ((contMDiff_val U) y).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  rw [hd.mfderiv]
  have heq : writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) y
      (Subtype.val : U → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) y) y)] id := by
    have ht : (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.target ∈
        𝓝 ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℂ, ComplexModel n) y) y) :=
      (complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.open_target.mem_nhds
        ((complexChartAt (n := n) y).val.map_source (mem_complexChartAt_source y))
    filter_upwards [ht] with z hz
    exact coordinateMap_val_complexChartAt y hz
  simp only [modelWithCornersSelf_coe, range_id, fderivWithin_univ]
  rw [heq.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
  exact Function.bijective_id

theorem exceptionalLocus_val : exceptionalLocus n (Subtype.val : U → M) = ∅ :=
  eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun y hy => hy (mfderiv_val_bijective y)
